with a letter bubble that ticks as it moves.

g.text: Thanks, I will test the new DNS…

svg.text: Mail, call and invite actions. The key chip shows
whether Croft can encrypt to this person. Recent
Save is disabled until something changes. The
account picker chooses which address book stores
the contact. Leaving with changes asks.
Croft wireframes · green = primary action · wax red = destructive · amber = star and snooze · blue = read state · wax tags = behaviour notes
